newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Saturday amid low demand from textile mills, dealers said.
The mills had sufficient stocks to last till mid-February and had gone to the sidelines, said dealer Kishin Chand of the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA).
The mills were likely to start buying after the Moslem Eid Al-Fitr festival in the second week of February, he said.
In the kerb market, the rate for NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,310 and 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), Chand said.
